description: write-sorted-kv-pair-slot with what the port does. A sorted_kv_pair slot is part of a sorted map's structure, and the port refuses a write of one with StructuralSlot before writing anything (finding 3), where Zig writes it wherever it's given. A key through a pair can't be written either, by any way to write, the byte writer included (finding 2), where Zig writes it and breaks the order. Neither poisons the transaction, which goes on and commits. What the port writes is what Zig writes with those writes left out.
